metrics.auc: exact integral of the empirical solve-rate step function over log2 budget; misses contribute zero area

cache.scope: shared across all sequential evaluation cells

in_situ_bits.definition: -log2 of epsilon-smoothed policy mass on the certified set of all shortest first actions after the production type mask
in_situ_bits.headline_coverage_gate: each weighting uses its own inverse-probability coverage
in_situ_bits.population: states scored by the untimed production-search replay

sample.method: lowest sha256 rank within task and rollout depth

weightings.task-balanced: state-weighted mean within task, then equal weight per task

search.cost_definition: one per type-compatible basis function attempted, including an attempt whose function raises
